description.en: The ID of the access configuration.

description.zh:
当您移除一个RD账号上使用某访问配置的最后一个授权时，是否同时解除访问配置部署。取值：

- DeprovisionForLastAccessAssignmentOnAccount：解除访问配置部署。
- None（默认值）：不解除访问配置部署。
description.en:
Specifies whether to de-provision the access configuration when you remove the access permissions from the CloudSSO identity. The access configuration is used to assign the access permissions, and the identity is the only one that uses the access configuration and is associated with the account. Valid values:

- DeprovisionForLastAccessAssignmentOnAccount: de-provisions the access configuration.

- None: does not de-provision the access configuration. This is the default value.

description.zh:
云SSO身份ID。具体如下：

- 当`PrincipalType`为`User`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户ID。
- 当`PrincipalType`为`Group`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the CloudSSO identity.

- If you set `PrincipalType` to `User`, set `PrincipalId` to the ID of the CloudSSO user.

- If you set `PrincipalType` to `Group`, set `PrincipalId` to the ID of the CloudSSO group.

description.zh:
云SSO身份类型。取值：

- User：用户。
- Group：用户组。
description.en:
The type of the CloudSSO identity. Valid values:

- User

- Group
The ID of the task object.

description.zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。
description.en: The type of the task object. Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory.

descriptions.zh:
该API操作为异步操作。您可以使用返回参数中的`TaskId`，调用[GetTask](~~340670~~)查询任务执行状态。

本文将提供一个示例，移除RD账号`114240524784****`上云SSO用户`u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk****`使用访问配置`ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`的授权。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, an asynchronous task is created. You can call the [GetTask](~~340670~~) operation to query the progress of the task based on the value of the `TaskId` response parameter.

This topic provides an example on how to remove the access permissions on the account `114240524784****` in the resource directory from the CloudSSO user `u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk****`. The access permissions are assigned by using the access configuration `ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso delete-access-assignment --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --principal-type User --principal-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --deprovision-strategy None --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudsso DeleteAccessAssignment --region cn-hangzhou --DeprovisionStrategy None --DirectoryId 'd-00fc2p610000' --PrincipalId 'u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000' --TargetType 'RD-Account' --AccessConfigurationId 'ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000' --PrincipalType User --TargetId 1142405247840000
